standard.title: U.S. SEC Rules Governing Mutual-Fund Net Asset Value (NAV) Computation and Pricing
citations: 17 CFR 270.22c-1 (Pricing of redeemable securities; forward pricing)
17 CFR 270.2a-5 (Good faith determinations of fair value)
15 U.S.C. 80a-2(a)(41) (Investment Company Act of 1940 §2(a)(41), definition of "value")
standard.scope: Registered open-end investment companies (mutual funds); NAV computation, portfolio valuation, accrual, cadence, forward pricing, good-faith fair-value determinations.
standard.source_note: law.cornell.edu (LII) mirror of eCFR/USC; eCFR.gov blocked automated retrieval. CFR Title 17 is regulation (not yet in the uslm Title-26 corpus); ingest via the RFC-001 §6 normative-document track. IRC tax-lot (§1012/§6045, Title 26 USC) is internalizable today via the uslm vertical.
standard.ingest_target: rfc: vocabulary as :NormativeStatement -> :Theorem (normative-is-theorem.rule); modality maps to :Modality; depends_on maps to :dependsOn / :premise.

claims.statement: A registered investment company's current net asset value must be computed substantially in accordance with the valuation, accrual, and timing rules of Rule 2a-4, with estimates used where necessary or appropriate.
claims.quote: Current net asset value ... means an amount which reflects calculations ... made substantially in accordance with the following, with estimates used where necessary or appropriate

claims.statement: Current net asset value is, in substance, the aggregate value of assets reduced by accrued liabilities, per share.
claims.quote: an amount which reflects calculations ... made substantially in accordance with the following
claims.notes: Composite of (a)(1) asset valuation + (a)(4) expense accrual + (a)(5)-(6) income accrual; not a single verbatim phrase.

claims.statement: Portfolio securities with readily available market quotations must be valued at current market value; all other securities and assets must be valued at fair value.
claims.quote: Portfolio securities with respect to which market quotations are readily available shall be valued at current market value, and other securities and assets shall be valued at fair value
claims.notes: Mirrors statutory 'value' in 15 U.S.C. 80a-2(a)(41); fair-value leg governed by 2a-5.

claims.statement: Under the Act, 'value' for pricing means market value where quotations are readily available, otherwise fair value as determined in good faith by the board.
claims.quote: (i) ... the market value of such securities; and (ii) ... fair value as determined in good faith by the board of directors
claims.notes: Legal anchor for 2a-4(a)(1) and 2a-5; origin of the board's good-faith duty.

claims.statement: Determining fair value in good faith requires assessing/managing valuation risks, selecting and consistently applying methodologies, testing them, and overseeing pricing-service providers.
claims.quote: determining fair value in good faith ... requires [risk assessment, methodologies, testing, pricing-service oversight]
claims.notes: Four enumerated functions of a good-faith determination.

claims.statement: A market quotation is readily available only when it is an unadjusted quoted price in active markets for identical investments accessible at the measurement date; otherwise the investment must be fair-valued.
claims.quote: a market quotation is readily available only when that quotation is a quoted price (unadjusted) in active markets for identical investments that the fund can access at the measurement date

claims.statement: Good-faith fair-value determinations must be performed by the board itself or by a designated valuation designee under board oversight.
claims.quote: performance of fair value determinations ... by the board ... or [by] a valuation designee ... subject to the board's oversight

claims.statement: A valuation designee must report to the board, segregate fair-value determinations from portfolio management, and notify the board of material matters within a board-set period not later than five business days.
claims.quote: reasonably segregate fair value determinations from the portfolio management ... within a time period determined by the board (but in no event later than five business days ...)
claims.notes: Five-business-day cap on notice of material matters.

claims.statement: Changes in holdings of portfolio securities must be reflected no later than the first calculation on the first business day following the trade date.
claims.quote: Changes in holdings of portfolio securities shall be reflected no later than in the first calculation on the first business day following the trade date

claims.statement: Changes in outstanding shares from distributions, redemptions, and repurchases must be reflected no later than the first calculation on the first business day following the change.
claims.quote: Changes in the number of outstanding shares ... shall be reflected no later than in the first calculation on the first business day following such change

claims.statement: Expenses, including investment advisory fees, must be included accrued to the date of calculation.
claims.quote: Expenses, including any investment advisory fees, shall be included to date of calculation

claims.statement: Dividends receivable must be included to the date of calculation, at ex-dividend or record dates as appropriate.
claims.quote: Dividends receivable shall be included to date of calculation either at ex-dividend dates or record dates, as appropriate

claims.statement: Interest income and other income must be included accrued to the date of calculation.
claims.quote: Interest income and other income shall be included to date of calculation

claims.statement: The (a)(4) expense and (a)(6) interest/other-income items need not be reflected if, netted, they do not amount to as much as one cent per outstanding share.
claims.quote: need not be so reflected if cumulatively, when netted, they do not amount to as much as one cent per outstanding share
claims.notes: De minimis permission; nets expenses against income.

claims.statement: A fund, its principal underwriter, and dealers must not sell, redeem, or repurchase a redeemable security except at a price based on the current NAV next computed after receipt of the order or tender.
claims.quote: No registered investment company ... shall sell, redeem, or repurchase any such security except at a price based on the current net asset value ... which is next computed after receipt of a tender ... or of an order

claims.statement: Current NAV must be computed no less frequently than once daily, Monday through Friday (subject to holiday/no-activity exceptions).
claims.quote: The current net asset value of any such security shall be computed no less frequently than once daily, Monday through Friday

claims.statement: The specific time(s) of day at which NAV is computed must be set by the board of directors.
claims.quote: at the specific time or times during the day that the board of directors of the investment company sets

claims.statement: An open-end fund (other than a money-market fund or ETF) may adjust NAV per share by a swing factor when net flows exceed a board-approved threshold, under a board-approved policy.
claims.quote: [price] may be adjusted by a swing factor ... if the level of net purchases [or] net redemptions ... has exceeded ... the swing threshold

claims.statement: A separate account funding variable annuities may apply a purchase payment at the NAV computed within a limited number of business days after order receipt.
claims.quote: [separate account] ... shall be deemed to satisfy ... if [the payment] is applied at the net asset value next computed [within the specified days]
